sessionStart.bash: r="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/hooks/session_start.py" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$r/hooks/session_start.py" --format copilot; else echo '{}'; fi
sessionStart.powershell: $r = @($env:PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; $f = if ($r) { Join-Path $r 'hooks/session_start.py' } else { '' }; if ($f -and (Test-Path $f) -and (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { python $f --format copilot } else { '{}' }
